stage: G-V1 V4-RECT: captive printed sliding buttons, tighter non-clamping screen lip
rear_panel_status: 3.5mm rear plate, local key-tongue relief leaves 1.55mm floor; ribbed, independent seam stop
assembly_order: Rear + PCB first; lower EMPTY front along -Z; close four shell screws; insert printed buttons from -X, then fasten removable common retainer. Remove retainer/buttons before lifting front.

pcb_screw.kind: M2.5x5 machine screw into original metal insert

shell_screw.kind: 2.0x6 plastic thread-forming screw; low cylindrical/pan head envelope; supplier SKU/PA12 pilot/torque UNVERIFIED, no DIN7981 claim
shell_screw.status: UNVERIFIED supplier selection: head <=3.6x1.2; length <=6.2; pocket 4.2x1.9; pilot1.7 candidate. No DIN7981/ISO7049 claim.

rear_ribs.status: internal stiffeners, clear of PCB seats, battery, speaker and wire lanes

tf_opening: removed; TF card stays inside and is reached by opening the clamped rear cover
speaker_wire_entry: +Y edge (toward the battery; the photo's speaker bottom), not -Y
usb_opening: unchanged 13.2 x 7.3mm after user insertion test; no reduction

mic_port.status: UNVERIFIED V4 channel-entry candidate moved outside strengthened lip base. V1 CAD candidate 27.3,1.395 is NOT a V1 printed-hole measurement; measure V1 actual hole and MEMS inlet before accepting either location.

mic_note: (27.3,1.395) is a V1 CAD candidate only; measure V1 printed/drilled hole relative to glass edges and inlet before accepting; acoustics UNVERIFIED.

jlc_rules.source: 嘉立创3D打印设计规范 (jlc-3dp.cn/technicalColumnsDetails/27832.html) and JLC3DP design guideline
jlc_rules.fastener_positioning_wall: >1.5mm design target; lip 1.5 with 1.6 radial base; actual strength UNVERIFIED
jlc_rules.printed_threads: Printed thread min M6 separate from self tapping; boss >=1.5x screw OD; PA12 tapping pilot/torque must be validated.

corner_bosses.status: RT moved away from battery; actual tray rails terminate before RT; no obsolete MX0 loop

battery_stack.status: Budgets are design candidates, not measured battery swelling or vendor guarantees; lead faces screen/mainboard and is UNMODELED.

first_print_evidence.interpretation: One lateral total-gap observation, NOT proof of plus/minus0.1 in all axes or flatness. User confirmed inference only.

screen_fit_scenarios.warp_and_tilt: UNVERIFIED and separate from size error; prior larger sensitivity retained, no hard glass contact or foam preload

retired_0127.reason: Insufficient direct exposed-face reach; no silicone dimensions invented. Historical files remain in git; not current print parts.

printed_keys.status: UNVERIFIED physical travel/force, shrink and free play; nominal geometric travel is not switch rating. No preload or glue. Variants are optional same-batch spares, maximum tip plane unchanged.
printed_keys.zero_fit_status: User-requested optional nominal axial zero gap; flange and tip +0.25mm preserve maximum inward tip. Sliding radial clearance remains0.30. Actual print may preload the switch; fit must be checked, not guaranteed.
